notes: The Wear OS client from the same Pocket Casts repository: :wear declares 21 @Preview functions over the now-playing, episode, sign-in and error surfaces, all Wear Compose Material and all plain @Preview, so previewAnnotations is not needed. Smaller and more screen-shaped than the design-system import, which is the point of having both. The catalog omits nine components: upstream names six of its previews simply Preview(), which a catalog spec cannot address individually because it resolves by function name — the old fork renamed them in place, and that rename is the kind of thing worth sending upstream rather than carrying here. Licence: MPL-2.0. Four renders are excluded, all IllegalStateException: Given component holder class androidx.activity.ComponentActivity does not implement — Hilt entry points these previews resolve through the application. Three fail only at wearos_small_round and keep their catalog entries, since the large-round permutation renders; LoggingInScreenPreview fails outright, so its entry goes. 24 of 28 render.
